_twist: B. Gap value scaling (intensity 3): columnGap and rowGap multiplied by 1.4× across responsive breakpoints. bp-810px: 96px × 1.4 = 134px; bp-1024px: 64px × 1.4 = 90px. Creates more spacious editorial breathing room in the grid — aligns with the botanical-archive aesthetic of generous whitespace. No color values changed.
